rule: Coin flips only, 47%-53% band. Small and researched: 7 picks. Every pick records what was checked and what was found.
seed: 20261009 -- sides dealt by seed; which markets were kept is stated, not tossed
note: Built at 4:05 PM PT, late in the day, which exposed a real bug: card.py filtered candidates by DATE only, so five games already in play (Columbia/Marist, FSU/Louisville, SEA/DET, NYR/WAS, PIT/CBJ) were eligible. An in-play price has moved on what happened in the game. Fixed before building; this card contains only games that had not started.

research.cross_venue: DK (via ESPN) vs Polymarket on all 7 markets: totals IDENTICAL on 4 of 5 games, spreads within 0.5-1 point. Same result as every day this week.
research.nhl_closing_line_audit: Settled this week and the headline negative: the DraftKings closing total at NHL 6.5 went over 282/563 = 50.1%. pickcenter was confirmed to hold the CLOSE, not the open (matched live odds on 8 unstarted games; retained the later number on 5 of 16 that moved after a pre-kickoff reading). So the closing line is honest to a tenth of a point on the rung this card bets.
research.props_not_used: Audited 189 arithmetic constraints across 183 quoted props: 0 executable violations. And once the half-spread is paid, an MLB prop needs ~5.0 points of edge and a CFB prop ~9.0, against ~2.0 for a game-spread coin flip. The thin end of the board is the expensive end, so no props here.
research.in_play_excluded: 5 games dropped for being under way. card.py now requires the start to be in the future.
research.verdict: Still nothing. Four days of checks -- cross-venue, ladder arbitrage, conditional closing-line audit, prop arithmetic -- have each come back empty. No pick here claims an edge.
